boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission social activities documented as free by UCR or California State Parks; check the linked pages for registration, weather, and schedule updates.

cards.title: Bring a friend to Storytime with Teresa
cards.subtitle: UCR Botanic Gardens · First Sunday series
cards.notes: Meet at the Gardens on a first Sunday from January through October for the listed seasonal Storytime program; check the calendar and posted notices before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal storytime at UCR’s living plant museum.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Botanic Gardens lists Storytime with Teresa as part of its free first-Sunday seasonal series, January through October.
cards.access_notes: First Sunday seasonal series; review current Garden hours, closures, and parking details before visiting.

cards.title: Fold something together at Origami with Michelle
cards.subtitle: UCR Botanic Gardens · First Sunday series
cards.notes: Plan for a first Sunday between January and October, when the Gardens lists this free seasonal origami activity; confirm the day’s program before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on, free Garden activity on select first Sundays.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Botanic Gardens lists Origami with Michelle as part of its free first-Sunday seasonal series, January through October.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled on first Sundays in the seasonal series; check the Gardens calendar and current entry hours.

cards.entity_name: UC Master Gardener Docents in the Butterfly Garden
cards.title: Ask a docent about the Butterfly Garden
cards.subtitle: UCR Botanic Gardens · 1st and 3rd Sundays
cards.notes: Visit the Butterfly Garden on a first or third Sunday from April through October to speak with the UC Master Gardener Docents during their listed morning hours.
cards.short_summary: A free chance to explore the Butterfly Garden with on-site docents.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR states that UC Master Gardener Docents are available in the Butterfly Garden on first and third Sundays, April through October.
cards.access_notes: Listed for 9 a.m.–noon on first and third Sundays, April–October; stay on designated trails and check conditions first.

cards.entity_name: First Thursday ArtsWalk at UCR ARTS
cards.title: See UCR ARTS during First Thursday ArtsWalk
cards.subtitle: California Museum of Photography and Culver Center of the Arts
cards.notes: Meet downtown during First Thursday ArtsWalk and browse the galleries together; UCR ARTS lists free admission for all during this monthly evening window.
cards.short_summary: Free evening gallery access during UCR ARTS’ First Thursday ArtsWalk.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR ARTS states that First Thursday ArtsWalk offers free admission for all, from noon to 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: UCR ARTS lists First Thursday ArtsWalk hours as noon–9 p.m.; confirm exhibitions and any ticket instructions before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Family First Sundays at UCR ARTS
cards.title: Make a Sunday gallery plan at UCR ARTS
cards.subtitle: California Museum of Photography and Culver Center of the Arts
cards.notes: Use a Family First Sunday for a no-cost gallery meet-up downtown; pair the visit with a slow look at the current photography and contemporary-art exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A free UCR ARTS gallery day for visitors of all ages.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR ARTS states that Family First Sundays offer free admission for all from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Family First Sundays are listed 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify the current exhibition schedule and visitor instructions.

cards.title: Put UCR ARTS College Night on the calendar
cards.subtitle: UCR ARTS · October 1, 2026
cards.notes: Gather a group for the next College Night, which UCR ARTS describes as a free event with open galleries, art making, performances, and deejays.
cards.short_summary: A documented free college-focused UCR ARTS event.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR ARTS identifies College Night as a free event open to all and lists its next date as October 1, 2026.
cards.access_notes: UCR ARTS lists the next College Night for October 1, 2026; event information is forthcoming, so confirm details before attending.

cards.title: Try an AI and technology workshop together
cards.subtitle: UCR Library Workshops & Events
cards.notes: Choose an upcoming AI and Technology session for a practical shared work block; the Library lists these workshops as free for UCR students, faculty, and staff.
cards.short_summary: A free UCR Library workshop category focused on research technology.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library lists AI & Technology among its workshop topics and states that all workshops are free and open to UCR students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: For UCR students, faculty, and staff; registration is required. Check the linked events page for the next session and format.

cards.title: Work through research skills side by side
cards.subtitle: UCR Library Workshops & Events
cards.notes: Register for a Research Skills workshop when you want a structured, no-cost study session with a friend; the Library offers sessions in person and via Zoom.
cards.short_summary: Free research-skills instruction for the UCR community.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library lists Research Skills among its workshop topics and states that all workshops are free and open to UCR students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: For UCR students, faculty, and staff; registration is required. Most sessions are offered in person and via Zoom.

cards.title: Learn a tool at a Software Carpentry workshop
cards.subtitle: UCR Library Workshops & Events
cards.notes: Pick a Software Carpentry session for a low-pressure skills hang focused on Python, Git, or Unix Shell; reserve a spot through the Library’s event listing.
cards.short_summary: A free, hands-on UCR Library technology workshop category.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library lists Software Carpentry, including Python, Git version control, and Unix Shell basics, among its free workshops for the UCR community.
cards.access_notes: For UCR students, faculty, and staff; registration is required. Consult the events listing for available sessions.

cards.title: Get citations sorted in a free workshop
cards.subtitle: UCR Library Workshops & Events
cards.notes: Bring a project and attend a Citation Management workshop with a classmate; the Library includes this topic in its free, registration-required workshop program.
cards.short_summary: Free instruction for organizing citations and research sources.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library lists Citation Management among its workshop topics and states that all workshops are free and open to UCR students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: For UCR students, faculty, and staff; registration is required. Most sessions are offered in person and via Zoom.
